name: career-intelligence
description: Career Intelligence Engine (xHumanOS) v0.66.0 - FOUNDATION-FIRST FIX: session-logger hook contamination. The capture-prompt.sh + capture-response.sh hooks were polluting any cwd they fired in (not just Career OS workspaces): writing brain/sessions/ledger/ files, git-committing, and pushing to origin/main in unrelated repos (agent-marketplace, exponentialos, thewhyman-com, etc — 408 stray commits across 6 repos as of 2026-05-18). TWO bug fixes: (1) workspace-identity gate at top of each hook — exit silently if cwd is not a Career OS workspace (detected via CAREER_HOME match OR brain/identity/ marker OR .career-os-workspace sentinel); (2) scoped commit using `git commit -- <paths>` so the hook only commits paths it staged, never sweeping up other agents' work in the index. Carries forward: confidence-ladder + slash commands from v0.65.
